intro.line: Dominaria, long after the Brothers' War. The ice age is over, and old things are waking.
As she took the wheel of the Weatherlight for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.
The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?
In Urborg, the Cabal is gathering under a demon who says he has ruled every age.

finale.line: The Demonlord has ruled every age. Every ruin, myth, and nightmare proves his power.
The Cabal's story is broken, and its demon with it. Teferi's spark is back, Jhoira has her ship, and Karn is walking Dominaria again.
Recorded: Dominaria is saved. Far from here, Nicol Bolas is waiting for the planeswalkers to gather.

villainFinale.line: All hail the Demonlord Belzenlok, Evincar of the Stronghold, Scion of Darkness, Doom of Fools, Lord of the Wastes, Master of the Ebon Hand, Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal . . .
Nobody stops the Cabal. The Stronghold grows, and the Demonlord's story becomes the only story left.

battles.title: A Story Unfolds
battles.blurb: You arrive on Dominaria and meet Teferi, who has just come home. A band of the Cabal wants him gone.

scene.line: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?
An ancient nemesis rendered harmless long ago.
Sagas: each chapter happens in turn as lore counters are added, and the Saga leaves when the last chapter is done. Plan what is coming.

villainScene.line: All hail the Demonlord Belzenlok, Evincar of the Stronghold, Scion of Darkness, Doom of Fools, Lord of the Wastes, Master of the Ebon Hand, Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal . . .
My heart is not mine, it is Belzenlok's. All hearts are his, and all blood.

hero.half: Sagas read themselves, one chapter a turn.

battles.title: The Weatherlight Rises
battles.blurb: Jhoira has restored the Weatherlight. The Cabal's demons want it grounded.

scene.line: As she took the wheel of the Weatherlight for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.
You could say it was my pet project.
Historic: artifacts, legendary cards and Sagas all count. Some cards reward you for casting one.

villainScene.line: A pit yawned open, a column of oily smoke arose, and a towering form hissed, "I accept this offering."
Urborg used to be lovely—scenic volcanoes, respectable lich lords. Since the Cabal came with their nightmares and thrulls, it's all gone to the worms.

battles.title: Sisay's Heir
battles.blurb: Shanna Sisay's heir joins the crew. The Keldon raiders want everything on the ship and are ready to burn the rest.

scene.line: I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life.
Sometimes Shivan dragons toy with their food. Other times they just cook it.
Kicker: pay the extra cost and the spell does more. Hold a kicker card until you can afford the bigger version.

villainScene.line: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.
The Mountain gave the Flame to Kradak to light the furnaces of his people's hearts. The wanderers became Keldons, and he the first warlord.

battles.title: Karn Returns
battles.blurb: Karn, a silver golem built by Urza, faces the priests of the Cabal in their stronghold.

scene.line: Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves.
Ice may thaw, but malice never does.
Planeswalkers: add loyalty to use an ability, and they take attacks meant for you. Keep a creature home to protect them.

villainScene.line: The Demonlord has ruled every age. Every ruin, myth, and nightmare proves his power.
The seat of Belzenlok's power, the Stronghold serves as the gathering place for the Cabal as their dark influence spreads from Urborg.

battles.title: Radha's Heirs and Yargle
battles.blurb: Radha's heirs ride out against Yargle, Urborg's famously terrible glutton. Their big spells need a legend first.

scene.line: The study of magic began when the first mage taught herself to throw lightning.
Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.
Legendary sorceries can only be cast while you control a legendary creature or planeswalker. Keep a legend on the table first.

villainScene.line: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.
They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up.

hero.half: Cast a legend before the sorcery.

battles.title: Mono-Red
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in spring 2018: Mono-Red against Esper Teferi, burn against a slow control deck.

scene.line: The trick is, once you get moving, don't stop!
Tolarians teach the theory of pyromancy. The Ghitu prefer applied research.
Red wants to win before Teferi comes down. Keep attacking and burn their face.

villainScene.line: Long ago, I enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir. My homeland is gone, but its protectors remain.
We don't choose who comes here. We choose how long they stay.

battles.title: Steel Leaf Stompy
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in spring 2018: Steel Leaf Stompy, big elves and bigger beasts, against RB Aggro.

scene.line: One eye open to see the truth of the world. One eye covered to gaze at the goddess within.
Druids endure disaster as seeds endure winter. Now Krosa blooms once more.
Your elves get you ahead on mana. Play your biggest creature each turn and let their burn run dry.

villainScene.line: A shadow to swallow the light.
You should have seen the look on both their faces.

battles.title: The Demonlord
battles.blurb: Belzenlok's story is all he has. Teferi, Jhoira and Karn have a ship, a spark and a lot of old Dominaria behind them.

scene.line: You are not alone. You never were.
I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less.
He says he has ruled every age. He made that up. Break the story and the Cabal goes with it.

villainScene.line: The Demonlord has ruled every age. Every ruin, myth, and nightmare proves his power.
Fear the dark if you must, but don't mistake sunlight for safety.

hero.half: Race him before the Rite finishes.

half.line: Nothing is too broken to mend.

battles.title: Teferi, Hero of Dominaria
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a planeswalker who will not let you finish your turn.

archive.what: White-blue control decks built around Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, which untaps lands, draws cards and tucks a permanent away every turn.
archive.why: Teferi was a planeswalker that protected itself and generated card advantage in a format full of aggro decks.
archive.beat: Pressure Teferi with attackers, or make them spend counters and removal before they land it.
archive.after: Dominaria and Core Set 2019 rotated out of Standard in autumn 2019.
